WoW: Forever

Assassination Rogue

Poison and bleed pressure on a single target, built around MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee — it needs 21 Assassination talent points, which is the whole argument about this spec.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Assassination build has been tested. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended.

What Assassination is for

Poison and bleed pressure on one target, opened from StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration-0.001 secAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled.. AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee at level 18 is where the build starts to work, and at 21 Assassination points MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee becomes the builder: 60 energy, both weapons at once for 75% weapon damage each, 2 combo points, and +20% against a poisoned target. Cold BloodCold BloodTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration-0.001 secWhen activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%. sits earlier in the tree in Forever than it did in Classic (Icy Veins), and guarantees a crit on your next Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMelee, BackstabBackstabLevel 4 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee, AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee, EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMelee or MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee.

Sources genuinely disagree, and we are not going to pretend otherwise.

For: Icy Veins rates its levelling 4 out of 5 (tied with Combat's 4 out of 5; both sit at 3.0 Overall), and says "Assassination is likely to be very strong especially in this level bracket due to the potency of talents like Remorseless AttacksRemorseless AttacksTalentCastInstant."

Against: Wowhead, updated 2026/09/29, says "Assassination is wholly underwhelming at this level bracket. We don't have any of our essential kit, such as MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee, VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 secFinishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec, and Seal FateSeal FateTalentCastInstantYour critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 0% chance to add an additional Combo Point.. It will ultimately play the same as the Combat Rogue for now until we can gain access to some more impactful abilities."

Both agree on why 21 points matters: that is what MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee costs in the tree (ClassicWoW.gg), and reaching it needs roughly character level 30. Below that, Assassination leans on MaliceMaliceTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%., Remorseless AttacksRemorseless AttacksTalentCastInstant and LethalityLethalityTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%. — good passive numbers with no signature button. If you want a decision, it is ours and not a source's: our own reading is that Combat is the lower-risk levelling pick and that Assassination pays off once MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee is reachable.

Rotation

At level 20 all three Rogue specs play the same. Icy Veins says so on its own Assassination guide, and Wowhead's three level-20 guides confirm it by being largely interchangeable: "During the early stages of Rogue leveling, it is difficult to really differentiate the specializations."

  1. From 20, Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem on both weapons
  2. Open from StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration-0.001 secAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. with AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee
  3. BackstabBackstabLevel 4 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee behind the target, otherwise Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMelee
  4. At 5 combo points, Slice and DiceSlice and DiceLevel 10 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 sec if the target will survive its duration
  5. Otherwise EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMelee at 5 combo points

Once MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee is reachable, it becomes your builder in place of Backstab/Sinister Strike, with Slice and DiceSlice and DiceLevel 10 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 sec upkeep unchanged.

Multi-target: no source publishes an Assassination area rotation. The only relevant note is that Remorseless AttacksRemorseless AttacksTalentCastInstant "heavily incentivizes pulling multiple mobs", it rewards chain-killing, which is not the same as cleaving.

Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, critical strike, Strength, Stamina.

Published gear advice adds: slow main hand, fast off hand, and "Intellect and Spirit are wasted on a rogue."

What Forever changed for Rogues

  • Poisons and Lockpicking are secondary skills now, "like First Aid", not class skills. Poison damage is lower with more charges — Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem rank 1 is "13 to 17 instead of 19 to 25, 60 instead of 40". Poison and a sharpening stone now stack.
  • MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee and VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 secFinishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec are both new.
  • Improved GougeImproved GougeTalentCastInstant moved in from Combat; Improved EviscerateImproved EviscerateTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%. moved out to Combat. Puncturing WoundsPuncturing WoundsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point. is a new Combat talent that buffs MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMelee, which is why the two trees now talk to each other.
  • Rogues can learn axes, and the skill starts at 1.
  • Baseline nerfs: RuptureRuptureLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration6 sec rank 6 is "159 instead of 272"; EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMelee rank 6 was lowered. The base Expose ArmorExpose ArmorLevel 14 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration30 sec ability was buffed to "450 instead of 340" armor per combo point at rank 5 — but the separate Improved Expose ArmorImproved Expose ArmorTalentCastInstant talent (2 ranks) no longer adds to that armor value. It now cuts the ability's Energy cost (5/10) and refunds 1–2 combo points when cast at 5 combo points (Icy Veins, ClassicWoW.gg). Fixed October 1: a missed Expose Armor no longer costs you all your combo points (Blizzard) — the finisher is safe to throw at low hit chance.
  • Hit and critical strike are now unified across spell, melee and ranged.

At level 60

Unknown: whether poison scaling and VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 secFinishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec upkeep make Assassination competitive with Combat in raids. There is no raid PTR, item stats are hidden until the items drop, and both 31-point capstones are untested.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools.
